Name: Werewolf Clint (Zylo)
Author: LykoTheReticent
Description:
This mod turns Clint into the werewolf Zylo from Shining Force. The portrait was made from images of Zylo from two different games as well as Gerhalt from Shining Force II. The sprites are modified versions of those from the SF games combined with Clint's blacksmith tools.

This mod does not change Clint's character background, dialogue, or other aspects in any way. I just liked the idea of Clint being a werewolf who is generally accepted by everyone in Pelican Town but is also lonely and quiet because he is so different.

I was inspired to make this mod by:
- The "Emily and the Wolf" mod.
- Perrin from the Wheel of Time series.
- The amazing Zylo, Gerhalt, and Baron sprites from the Shining Force series.
- There aren't enough werewolves in videogames :(

Enjoy!
